domains.name: Visual Evidence Interpretation
domains.scope: Specify visible distinctions between documented evidence, inferred reconstructions, measurements, and model outputs in visual scenes.

skills.name: reconstruction-evidence-visual-labeling

skills.name: simulation-observation-display-separation
